contexts.text: With [idiots] the Rational cannot be elevated.

Those who in the world had been idiots, on their arrival in the other world are likewise foolish and idiotic; but when their externals are removed and their internals opened... they are then endowed with an understanding in accordance with their genius and their previous life; for real madness and insanity reside in the external or natural, and not in the internal or spiritual man.
